exposure: epidural analgesia with 0.125% bupivacaine and 1.5% lidocaine
epidural analgesia with 0.25% bupivacaine with 1.0% lidocaine concentrations
cohort: 100 full-term pregnant women undergoing cesarean section (50 in each group)
finding: While both epidural analgesia concentrations provided similar pain relief, the higher concentration of bupivacaine (0.25%) was associated with a significantly higher rate of adverse events, particularly hypotension.
